description: A histogram bucket aggregation over a numeric column. Must specify extended_bounds or hard_bounds so the bucket count is bounded.

field.description: Required. The numeric column to bucket.

interval.description: Required. Bucket width. Must be positive.

min_doc_count.description: Optional. Minimum document count for a bucket to be returned.

offset.description: Optional. Shifts bucket boundaries by this amount.

order.description: Optional. Bucket sort order — a {metric: "asc|desc"} object or an array of them.

missing.description: Optional. Bucket value assigned to documents missing field.

format.description: Optional. Format applied to the bucket key in the response.
